cases.title: Seltiss-2 main battery contradictory attack bonuses
cases.finding: Preserve Ranged +2 vs weapon row +4; schema must support uncorrected printed disagreement.

cases.title: Seltiss-2 detachable independent cabin
cases.finding: Parent ship carries a detachable and separately statblocked transport; preserve distinct source identity and deployment relation.

cases.title: Dagger printed drive narrative without multiplier
cases.finding: Hyperdrive present per prose, numeric rate source-silent; navicomputer only stores three jumps and life-support/shields absent per prose.

cases.title: Freefall operator-specific crew bonus
cases.finding: Four required duty stations, each provides its own crew member +1 on related rolls; bonus conditional and station-scoped.

cases.title: Scurrg generator reload and buffer state
cases.finding: Generates one bomblet every ten rounds, stores up to ten energy spheres, exchangeable for proton bomb chute; preserve target-size penalty.

cases.title: Stock vs explicitly mentioned named modifications
cases.finding: Different stock versions and named modified ships in adjacent prose must not silently inherit into stock records.

cases.title: Source-confirmed silence in weapon hardware and arcs
cases.finding: Store reviewed silence without equating an attack group, autofire option or ammunition with a physical launcher count.

cases.title: Booster-ring conditional starfighter hyperdrive and consumables
cases.finding: Both Delta-7 and Eta-2 variants require optional booster ring for x1 drive and/or a week of supplies; source defines no unconditional ship hyperdrive for these variants. Azure Angel has separately printed unqualified x1 and one-week lines.

cases.title: Conditional astromech skill substitution and navigational memory
cases.finding: Printed Mechanics/Use Computer starred alternative +13 and ten-jump astromech memory do not imply unconditional crew skill modifiers or a standalone ship navicomputer.

cases.title: Special conditional Pilot bonus for Delta-7 High-Speed
cases.finding: High-Speed Delta-7 Pilot +13 normally and +20 solely when increasing vehicle speed; separate rule rather than altered base skill.

cases.title: Named Azure Angel distinct variant and unpriced/unsalable availability
cases.finding: Azure Angel printed no availability, cost Not available for sale; unique modified Delta-7, 16 torpedoes payload not torpedo tube count, conditional booster-ring data not copied.

cases.title: Printed shield absence versus explicit SR15 between Eta-2 variants
cases.finding: High-Maneuver Eta-2 defenses have no SR line, while Heavy-Defenses Eta-2 explicitly SR 15. Preserve source-silent vs printed field and avoid default 0 or automatic variant inheritance.

cases.title: Printed weapon battery counts versus gunner complement
cases.finding: Charger, MedStar and Pelta provide battery numbers and multi-gunner crews, not individual gun barrel counts; separate reported battery quantity, crew station requirement and physical hardware.

cases.title: Attack-scale and multiple firing positions on troop shuttles
cases.finding: Kappa prints starship-scale double blasters and character-scale two heavy repeating blasters, requiring mode/scale independent targeting and separate pilot/copilot/gunner stations.

cases.title: Modular Pelta interior wings and loadout state
cases.finding: Pelta movable wing profile and modular hospital interior are shipyard/servicing operations measured in hours/days, not free combat switching or second independent ship identity.

cases.title: Nu shuttle unprinted hyperspace vs absent value
cases.finding: Nu printed statblock gives no drive or navigational multiplier; encode SOURCE_SILENT_CONFIRMED without importing from narrative expectations or neighbor ships.

cases.title: BTL-S1 Y-wing alternate simultaneous attack patterns
cases.finding: Printed medium lasers + ion OR lasers + proton torpedoes, with gunner ion/torpedo stations and conditional astromech +13 skills. Keep alternating combinations and explicit station assignments.

cases.title: Printed target size penalty at capital weapon rows
cases.finding: Charger and Pelta print -20 attack penalty against targets smaller than Colossal, with explicit modified battery attack bonuses. Must not indiscriminately apply to every point-defense mount.

cases.title: Pelta malformed attack-options token and statblock continuation
cases.finding: Printed Pelta attack options literal "if any" is not a named option. Statblock continues p173; source parser must retain unusual text without creating a phantom combat action.

cases.title: Physical carried-craft capacity and interior reconfiguration
cases.finding: CR-20 racks carry twelve bikes; Kappa alternatives are two AT-RT or two ISP, with optional trooper-space conversion; MedStar supports up to twelve Colossal carried vessels, not fixed installed craft.

cases.title: Conditional Belbullab models under one printed statblock
cases.finding: Three model-specific weapon rows (-22, -23, -24) within one print identity require variant-conditioned hardware, damage and ammo.

cases.title: Named Soulless One separated from generic Belbullab
cases.finding: Own statblock and pilot/hyperdrive/availability; prohibit borrowing B24 missiles.

cases.title: Droch boarding-drill dynamic attachment
cases.finding: Adjacent standard attack -> collision-free attach -> standard-action grapple damage ignoring SR -> cumulative damage > DT breaching.

cases.title: Hardcell critical vulnerability
cases.finding: Incoming critical damage multiplier is triple not double, independent of weapon battery output.

cases.title: Hyena multi-weapon droid concurrency
cases.finding: Crew zero; independent gunner-equivalent three simultaneous weapons and dual ammunition families.

cases.title: Punworcca crew-conditional skills and station
cases.finding: FA-4-only pilot alters Initiative, Perception, Pilot, Use Computer and base attack; microtractor-pressor uses p198 rule: grapple bonus halved, successful grapple permits pushing 10 character squares (1 starship square).

cases.title: Printed page and PDF page scan inversion
cases.finding: Phase1 Punworcca p209 conflicts with printed p210 found at PDF index209; PDF index210 shows printed p209. Keep key, flag controlled provenance correction.

cases.title: C-9979 carried craft and modular wing transport
cases.finding: Four distinct droid passenger subtypes, three carried ground vehicle families, detachable wings; not installed ship weapons.

cases.title: Diamond batteries vs droid complements
cases.finding: Two batteries each six gunners, but no per-battery barrel count; carries 600 OG-9 and 2400 DSD1 droids.

cases.title: Source-silent weapon families for luxury transport
cases.finding: No printed Ranged attack and narrative says low firepower; unknown complete mount inventory not default to inferred 0 across schematic.

cases.title: Missing hyperdrive and shields in specialized ships
cases.finding: C-9979, Droch, Hyena have no printed hyperdrive; Droch and Hyena no printed SR: neither zero nor inherited values.

cases.title: Separatist crew environment constraints
cases.finding: Hardcell crew cabins support Skakoans without suits; other species require flight/space suits.

cases.title: Automatic Sheathipede noncombat flight
cases.finding: Sheathipede automated destination-following and passenger speech input are narrative operation, not an autonomous combat gunner or weapon.

cases.title: Phase1 Sheathipede print-page correction required
cases.finding: Phase1 stores Sheathipede p209, but statblock is printed p210 at PDF index209; leave identity untouched and issue controlled source page correction.

cases.title: Named Providence-class variant separate
cases.finding: Stock Providence CL18 and Invisible Hand CL20 have materially different crew, capacity, hyperdrive, capital weapon attack numbers and carried craft.

cases.title: Capital size-conditional attack modifiers
cases.finding: Capital weapons get -20 against smaller-than-Colossal targets, while point defense remains separately typed; record both base and small-target modifiers.

cases.title: Capital battery multiplicities and physical mount ambiguity
cases.finding: 3 dual laser and 8 torpedo batteries imply arrays but not actual turret/launch tubes, while 2,800 torpedoes is ammo, not launchers.

cases.title: Subjugator tactical fire area attack
cases.finding: Standard action suppresses all squares within 2 starship-scale squares; successful attacks vs ships within area add two damage dice.

cases.title: Ion pulse starship-scale area attack and miss effects
cases.finding: Five starship-square area; attack each ship, hits deal 9d10x10 ion and two condition steps; misses half ion and one step.

cases.title: Ion pulse recharge and conditional destruction
cases.finding: Three consecutive full-round recharge actions and incoming threshold-damage shutdown destroying the cannon must persist as stateful machinery.

cases.title: Subjugator concurrent battery groups
cases.finding: Five weapon group families joined by AND plus multiple batteries and gunners, requiring distinct attack ownership and no conflation with pilot weapon list.

cases.title: Sabaoth fighter independent from carrier
cases.finding: Sabaoth Destroyer carries twelve starfighters, while a separately printed Sabaoth Starfighter has its own CL7 statblock on p221.

cases.title: Four cannons but unknown physical synchronization
cases.finding: Sabaoth fighter has four physically named laser cannons but a single pilot attack row; firing coordination and arc remain source-silent.

cases.title: No printed hyperdrive or SR on Sabaoth fighter
cases.finding: Absent hyperdrive and shield lines are marked SOURCE_SILENT_CONFIRMED, not forced zero or inherited stat from the destroyer.
